kai: heads up — planning a family sabbatical in Okinawa, JP and will work remote for ~8 weeks (2026-08-01 -> 2026-09-26). Quick checklist: 1) WFH stipend/proration? 2) any Japan withholding or benefits impact? 3) need to change homebase? 4) can IT ship a travel charger + spare dongle internationally?
maria (people-ops): congrats! TL;DR: stipend pro-rated by days in month; submit Temp Remote form and mark international; do not update homebase for temporary stays under 6 months.
nina (benefits): medical note: US plan may not cover local hospitals; telehealth + EAP ok. If you expect in-country care, please DM me and consider travel insurance.
omar (legal): Japan can have withholding/reporting depending on duration and visa. For ~8 weeks company nexus unlikely but payroll should estimate withholding and any reporting. Also check local work-visa rules.
tia (eng-manager): approved from my side. keep on-call coverage documented.
it-ops: we can ship charger + dongle but need signed equipment waiver and manager ok for international shipment. ETA 7-12 biz days.
payroll-bot: PR-5777 created to estimate stipend proration and any withholding delta (ETA 48-72 hrs).
